title: Small business marketing guide: ideas and strategies | Xero US

facts.fact: Xero's page advertises 80% off its plan for the first 3 months, per a footnote-marked offer.
facts.quote: Get 80% off your plan for your first 3 months\*

facts.fact: The Xero guide was published on Monday 20 April 2026.
Per a third-party research claim cited by Xero (emailmonday.com), automated email workflows generate 30x higher returns compared to one-off campaigns.
facts.quote: Research shows that automated email workflows generate [30x higher returns]

facts.fact: Per a third-party claim cited by Xero (Sprout Social), 81% of consumers are swayed by social media to make spontaneous purchases.
facts.quote: Given that 81% of consumers are [swayed by social media]

facts.quote: Apply the Four Ps method (product, price, promotion, and place)
